title: larrea humilis
intro: Larrea humilis, commonly known as Creosote Bush, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, and is believed to help alleviate symptoms associated with various conditions such as fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, Larrea humilis is also used in traditional medicine to support immune function and as a general tonic to promote overall well-being.
